title: My camera or microphone isn't working
summary: In a video call or class app, your camera is black or nobody can hear you.

steps.title: Check the camera for damage
instructions: Look at the camera at the top of your screen.
Check for cracks or broken pieces around it.
steps.question: Do you see any damage?

steps.title: Check for a camera cover
instructions: Some Chromebooks have a small sliding cover over the camera. If yours is closed, slide it open.
Some keyboards have a microphone mute key. If yours does, press it to turn the microphone back on.
Reload the page with the Refresh key (the circle arrow on the top row).
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Close other apps using the camera
instructions: Only one app can use the camera at a time.
Close other tabs and apps that might use the camera or microphone, like another video call.
Go back to your class app and reload the page.
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Test with the Camera app
instructions: Open the Launcher by clicking the circle in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
Check if you can see yourself. Then close the Camera app.
If only your microphone has a problem, answer Yes.
steps.question: Does the Camera app show your picture?

steps.title: Check the website's permissions
instructions: Go back to the website you were using.
Click the icon just left of the website address. It may look like a lock or two sliders.
Find Camera and Microphone. If either one says Block and you can change it, choose Allow.
steps.warning: If you can't change these settings, your school controls them. Do not try to get around them.
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
Sign in and open your class app again.
steps.question: Is it working now?
